description: Build ONE unsigned real swap (USDG to or from a Robinhood Stock Token) for your own wallet to sign. Refuses over your record-based cap, when the issuer has paused a token or blocked the wallet, when the pinned pool is shallow or its price is more than 1.5% from the real stock price, or when the market is closed. Exact-amount approval first if needed. Nothing is signed or sent here. The issuer can pause or block at any time; this is not advice and not a promise of any return.
name: prepare_real_swap
